title: Validated solitary profile

source.prescription: Recomputed epsilon=.025, mu=2, speed=0 periodic traveling branch; full-PDE residual checked before propagation.

notes: Design screens do not establish physical applicability.
Qualification belongs to these exact parameters, domain, grid, step and horizon.
Finite periodic propagation is not a soliton discovery or stability result.

diagnostic_definitions.peak_amplitude: max_tau |u| at each saved xi; envelope amplitude, not reconstructed free-surface elevation.
diagnostic_definitions.rms_width: sqrt(integral d(tau,c)^2 |u|^2 / integral |u|^2); d is signed shortest periodic distance about circular action centroid c. Broad/wrapped packets make this statistic ambiguous.
diagnostic_definitions.displacement: Unwrapped circular action-centroid displacement from xi=0. Defined only while the first circular moment is well separated from zero; not a group-velocity fit.
diagnostic_definitions.tail_action_fraction: Action outside periodic distance 8 from the moving circular action centroid divided by total action. Exterior action includes packet tails and spreading: it is not automatically radiation.
diagnostic_definitions.boundary_action_fraction: Fraction of action in fixed outer ten percent of the tau domain, |tau| > 0.45 L.
diagnostic_definitions.mass_relative_error: (action(xi)-action(0))/action(0), action=integral |u|^2 d tau. Conservation is a diagnostic, not an accuracy proof.
diagnostic_definitions.phase_shift: Unwrapped global phase from least-squares translation/global-phase fit against this case's initial complex envelope. Translation is fitted separately.
diagnostic_definitions.orbital_shape_error: Relative L2 distance to this case's initial complex envelope after removing its best translation and global phase. No amplitude rescaling is fitted. Genuine evolution of a Gaussian is expected.
diagnostic_definitions.profile_exterior_residual_action: For profile-based cases only: action of u minus its best translated/phased unperturbed solitary reference outside reference radius 8, divided by packet action. A radiation proxy, not a spectral radiation decomposition or error bar.
diagnostic_definitions.retained_spectral_edge_action_fraction: Fourier action fraction in outer twenty percent of retained |mode|<N/4 band.
diagnostic_definitions.epsilon_peak: epsilon max |u|; <=0.1 is a chosen weak-steepness screen, not a physical validity proof.
diagnostic_definitions.epsilon_spectral_sigma: epsilon times Fourier wavenumber standard deviation; <=0.1 is a chosen narrowband screen.
diagnostic_definitions.circular_concentration: Modulus of the normalized first circular action moment. Values near zero make center/width/displacement unreliable.

interpretation: One-coordinate spatial free-surface-envelope Dysthe; xi is propagation distance and tau is retarded time. Periodic boundary conditions and |D_tau| zero mode=0. Galerkin projector retains |mode|<N/4. Integrating-factor RK4. Padded continuum energy/momentum need not be invariants of the projected ODE or RK map. Exterior action is not automatically radiation.
